WITH acct_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM trans
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       a.avg_amount,
       a.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess
FROM acct_avg a
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE a.avg_amount > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;
